content: {"episode_id":"ep-05013","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229, mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring, for this episode. The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations, dizziness, and near-syncope that are intermittent and difficult to capture on standard ambulatory monitoring. Given the clinical suspicion of sick sinus syndrome (I49.5) and unspecified cardiac arrhythmia (I49.9), prolonged mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances over an extended period. On this documented basis, we request that the service be reviewed and covered as medically necessary."}
